home.title: Yi tambaya game da dokokin Najeriya.
home.intro: Yi tambaya yadda kake magana. Za ka sami amsa mai sauƙin fahimta da ainihin sassan da ta fito daga ciki.
home.paused: An dakatar da bayani na ɗan lokaci. Nemi sashe don ci gaba da karanta dokokin da aka wallafa.
suggestions: 'Yan sanda za su iya bincika wayata?
Har yaushe 'yan sanda za su iya tsare ni kafin a kai ni kotu?
Wa zai iya tsayawa takarar shugaban ƙasa?
home.disclaimer: Amsoshi suna bayyana dokokin da aka wallafa cikin harshe mai sauƙi, kuma za su iya rasa wasu bayanai. Duba sassan da suka nuna, kuma ka yi magana da lauya game da al'amarinka.

outcome.clarification_required: Wannan tambayar ta ƙunshi abubuwa da yawa a lokaci ɗaya. Gwada tambaya game da doka ɗaya, sashe ɗaya ko al'amari ɗaya.
outcome.validation_failed: Ba mu iya tabbatar da cewa bayanin ya dace da tanade-tanaden da aka wallafa ba, don haka ga sassan da kansu.
outcome.provider_failure: Babu bayani a yanzu. Ga sassan da aka wallafa da suka shafi lamarin.
outcome.budget_exhausted: Mun kai iyakar bayani na yau. Ga sassan da aka wallafa da suka shafi lamarin.
outcome.capacity_exhausted: Mutane da yawa suna yin tambayoyi yanzu. Ga rubutun da ya shafi lamarin; sake gwadawa bayan minti ɗaya.
outcome.closest: Tanade-tanaden da aka wallafa ba su amsa wannan kai tsaye ba. Ga sassan da suka fi kusa da muka samu.
outcome.noSection: Ba mu sami sashen da aka wallafa wanda ya amsa wannan ba. Gwada tambaya ta wata hanya, ko ka ambaci doka da sashe.
outcome.unfinished: Ba mu iya kammala wannan amsa ba. Ga sassan da aka wallafa da suka shafi lamarin.
